response.description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the behavior of each trained BERT4Rec model through the host ModelView interface and produces an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and their definitions.
response.motivation: Make model revisions evidence-driven while preserving benchmark comparability, BERT4Rec semantics, dataset routing, and the requirement for one independently trained model per category.
response.implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Return metrics and metric_definitions; explicitly mark unavailable measurements. Use view.model as the actual trained module and preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), and predict_score(features, items). Handle left padding using the final nonpadding position. Any predictive probe must respect masked-target training and appended-mask inference, without exposing targets in bidirectional inputs. Use only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; review content, ratings, commercial attributes, and simulator traits are unavailable. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for five real training users per category. Select revisions using macro validation HR@10 across all four categories, with fixed splits and seeds. Keep checkpoint loading and the embedded predictor consistent.
response.pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        switch view.model to evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            inspect supported public-data availability
            for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
                compute family-compatible diagnostics
                exclude padding and prevent target leakage
                accumulate measured values and valid counts
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: aggregated measurements, metric_definitions: definitions and availability}

diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics, definitions, and missing-data limitations
    request evidence-grounded interpretations and single-model BERT4Rec revisions
    prohibit invented observations and test-based selection

originality.positive: Connects architecture-aware diagnostics with a constrained iterative recommendation workflow.
originality.negative: The description specifies an adapter contract rather than a new diagnostic algorithm or learning method.

future_potential.positive: Could support reproducible diagnosis and targeted revisions as the BERT4Rec architecture evolves.
future_potential.negative: Its practical value depends on choosing informative probes and demonstrating validation gains; no results are supplied.

code_difficulty.positive: The fixed interfaces and batch shapes provide a clear integration boundary.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, padding, leakage prevention, metric aggregation, and predictor consistency require careful implementation.
